data.name: TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero
data.detailed_description:
TERRORSTORM: Ground Zero is a single-player FPS action-horror game with strong Soulslike DNA. 

You are a lone mercenary hired to save the daughter of a local government official who has been kidnaped by a criminal organization that chemically and surgically transforms people into horrific "products" to be auctioned off on the dark web. Prepare to engage in visceral, high-stakes combat against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets hidden deep within, and bring down a horrific underground crime ring. Think Resident Evil meets Dark Souls.

  • This game has been developed by a solo developer.

GAME FEATURES:

  • FPS Souls-like combat system

  • Ammo scarcity. Must be collected throughout the world, or can be bought with Blood Tokens (Souls) that you get from killing enemies, picking up special items or regained after death.

  • No healing. Health only replenishes at save-points (Bonfires).

  • Melee combat - the last resort option once out of ammo. Some melee items can be used to interact with the world and gain access to otherwise locked areas and items.

  • Rich interconnected world.

  • Souls-like exploration. Most valuable items can only be found in optional areas.

  • A crossover approach to storytelling, with the main plot-points expressed through scripted sequences and the details explained in item descriptions and environmental storytelling.

  • Original heavy metal soundtrack written and produced by yours truly \m/

Survive brutal, high-stakes encounters against dangerous and terrifying foes, uncover dark secrets and bring down horrific underground crime ring. Resident Evil tension meets Dark Souls punishment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 3GB / AMD RX 580 4GB / Intel Arc A380 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
